newsitem.title: GERMANY: Waigel to meet Tietmeyer this week on revaluation.
newsitem.headline: Waigel to meet Tietmeyer this week on revaluation.

text.p: German Finance Minister Theo Waigel said on Sunday he would meet Bundesbank President Hans Tietmeyer this week to discuss plans to revalue assets at the German central bank.
Waigel, speaking to Reuters on the fringes of a convention, declined to specify exactly when the talks would take place but indicated that revaluation of currency reserves would be the main topic.
It was not clear whether Germany's gold reserves were to be included in the discussions this week.

The revaluation plan has been at the centre of fierce controversy in recent weeks after the Bundesbank shot down Waigel's original plan to revalue gold and currency reserves this year, yielding a profit transfer that would ease Germany's path toward monetary union.
Bonn and the Bundesbank are now discussing a modified plan, of which full details are not yet fully apparent.
Waigel said on Saturday that an agreement on the issue was in sight.
